reference_form_notes: Frontmatter is a contract: name, an intent-plus-trigger description, and a metadata block declaring inputs (Task), output (VerificationResult), types (./scripts/contracts.py) and workspace. Body is unheaded, unbolded, undiagrammed prose: short declarative sentences, one responsibility each. The iteration limit is stated once, up front, as a bare sentence. Three numbered top-level steps. Parallelism is announced in the sentence that precedes the subagents. Each subagent is introduced as 'Subagent: <Role> (→ `<ResultType>`)' followed by two sentences of work and verdict rule. The decision is a three-branch closed list, each branch naming condition, action, and whether the run continues. No file names, no directory contents, no JSON field lists, no log mechanics, no per-phase user chatter. Closes with a single sentence naming the terminal result and the workspace.

writing_manner.reasoning: The candidate is the unedited source register: per-phase section headings, a fenced flow diagram, bold labels, shouted imperatives, telegraphic guardrail bullets with '=' shorthand, and meta-commentary about the orchestrator's own role. Nothing decorative has been removed, and several sentences carry no responsibility at all. This is the bottom of the scale, not a lightly-edited version of it.

what_to_fix_in_the_sculpting_skill: Nothing in the sculpting skill fired here — this is the un-sculpted source, held as the low anchor. Stated as the rule that would close the largest gap: the skill needs a hard rule that any field list, JSON payload, status enum or record shape appearing in the source must be moved into a typed file, declared in frontmatter metadata as `types:`, and referenced from the body only through a `(→ Type)` result marker on the stage that produces it — with the body forbidden from naming a single field. Without that rule the body has nowhere to delegate to, so the inline JSON schemas survive and drag altitude down with them; the frontmatter contract (`inputs`, `output`, `types`, `workspace`) must be required in the same rule, since it is what makes the delegation addressable.
